meta.name: Google Flow — structure DNA (the skeleton)
meta.description: Interaction and information architecture of Google Flow (labs.google/fx/tools/flow). This is the STRUCTURE half of the Studio fusion: we take Flow's skeleton (grid-as-canvas, floating contextual composer, drop-up param panel, media-as-editor, prompt-as-identity) and reject its skin (dark room, monochrome chrome). Extracted from a live click-through of a real project on 2026-08-21.
source_references: labs.google/fx/sr/tools/flow/project/4bda8910... (grid + composer + drop-up panel, image & video variants, model dropdown, card hover)
labs.google/fx/tools/flow/.../edit/<mediaId> (media detail editor with contextual composer + history panel)
higgsfield.ai/ai-video (secondary: labeled state-chip composer, for control readability only)

primary.role: canvas ground — the whole app background, near-black

secondary.role: elevated surface — composer, drop-up panel, dropdowns

accent.role: there is NO chromatic accent. 'Accent' = a lighter gray fill (#3a3a3c) marking the selected segment, or white text. Color comes ONLY from the generated media.

neutral.usage: A pure gray ramp. Ground → surface → hovered/selected surface → muted text → bright text. Zero hue anywhere in the chrome.

surface.card: transparent — media tiles have NO card; they ARE the surface, edge to edge
surface.elevated: #1c1c1e with a faint 1px lighter border and soft shadow (composer, panel)

color.contrast_strategy: Dark room. The chrome recedes to near-black so the eye never competes between UI and media; the only bright, saturated thing on screen is the generated content. Text is white/gray on black.

display.size: n/a — a tool, not a marketing page; no display type

heading_1.size: ~1rem (media title = the prompt, in the editor top bar)

font_families.heading: Google Sans / Product Sans-like geometric sans

typography.font_style_notes: Neutral, quiet, low-weight geometric sans. Type is deliberately un-styled so it never competes with media. Small sizes, regular/medium weights, no black weights, no personality. Type is chrome, not content.

spacing.content_density: comfortable-to-compact — controls are tight pills; the GRID is spacious (media given maximum room)
spacing.section_rhythm: media grid uses a small, even gutter (~12–16px); composer floats with generous margin from the viewport bottom

layout.grid_system: Three zones: (1) left taxonomy rail ~250px, (2) edge-to-edge media grid = the canvas, (3) floating composer bottom-center that hovers OVER the scrolling grid. The grid scrolls UNDER the translucent composer.
layout.max_content_width: full-bleed — the media grid uses all available width
layout.columns: 2 large columns on desktop for the media grid (very large tiles); masonry-ish by media aspect
layout.breakpoints: desktop-first; the rail collapses and composer adapts on narrow
layout.alignment_tendency: full-bleed grid, centered floating composer, left-aligned rail

shape.border_usage: almost none — surfaces separate by lightness, not by stroke. At most a faint 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08) hairline on elevated panels.
shape.divider_style: faint 1px light-on-dark hairline, or just a spacing gap; a thin rule under the rail's 'Uploads' before 'Tools'

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused — large-radius, low-opacity black shadows under the floating composer and drop-up panel; blur present (opposite of the platform)

levels.medium: composer bar: soft shadow + slight surface lift (#1c1c1e)
levels.high: drop-up panel / dropdown: larger soft shadow, sits above composer

elevation.depth_cues: surface lightness (darker=further) + soft blurred shadow + layering (composer over grid). NO offset, NO hard edge.

motion.entrance_pattern: drop-up panel scales/slides up from the composer; card chrome fades in on hover; editor cross-fades from the grid
motion.exit_pattern: reverse — panel collapses down into the chip
motion.philosophy: cinematic-restraint — motion is smooth and quiet, in service of continuity (the composer persists and morphs rather than being replaced), never decorative

components.button_style: quiet — icon buttons are bare circles that gain a subtle gray hover fill; the send button is a small circle with an arrow; no borders
components.input_style: the composer textarea is borderless, placeholder-only ('Šta želite da napravite?'), transparent on the surface
components.card_style: NO card. Media is presented raw, edge-to-edge; 'card' chrome (favorite/reuse/more pill, play+prompt, extend star) appears only on hover, floating on top of the media
components.navigation_pattern: left taxonomy rail that is NOT app-navigation but a media-library filter: All media · Images · Videos · Characters · Lighting · Uploads — rule — Tools — bottom: Trash · Collapse
components.modal_style: clicking media does NOT open a modal — it ROUTES to /edit/<id>, a full editor (player + timeline + history panel + the same composer). Detail-as-place, not detail-as-overlay.
components.list_style: dropdowns are simple dark rounded panels; model list = emoji + name rows with hover highlight
components.component_notes: THE central component is the composer: one persistent element with two intents. In the grid its placeholder is 'Šta želite da napravite?' and it CREATES. In the editor its placeholder is 'Opišite izmene' and it EDITS, with a different model in the chip. A summary state chip ('Video · 720p · 8s · x4') always mirrors the drop-up panel; clicking it opens the panel above. The panel is model-driven: switching Image↔Video changes which rows exist (video adds Frames/Ingredients + duration; image shows 5 ratios vs video's 2) and auto-selects a compatible model. A live credit line at the panel bottom updates as controls change.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a darkened editing suite / color-grading room — the walls disappear so the footage on the wall is all you see
aesthetic.era_influence: modern pro creative tooling (video editors, DAWs, After Effects dark UI)

visual_language.ornamentation: none — zero decoration; every pixel of chrome earns its place
visual_language.whitespace_usage: the black ground IS the whitespace; media is given maximal room
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: all weight on the media; chrome is near-weightless
visual_language.focal_strategy: the media is always the hero; chrome recedes until hovered
visual_language.contrast_level: high between media and ground, low within the chrome

composition.hierarchy_method: spatial isolation + darkness — the important thing (media) is bright and large, everything else is dim and small
composition.balance_type: mosaic (media grid) with a fixed floating anchor (composer)
composition.flow_direction: vertical scroll through the grid; the composer is a fixed gravity well at the bottom
composition.grouping_strategy: implicit — grouping by proximity and the taxonomy rail, never by drawn containers
composition.negative_space_role: dominant and load-bearing — the dark negative space is the entire readability strategy

imagery.photo_treatment: raw, full-bleed, uncropped-feeling; media is never framed or bordered
imagery.graphic_elements: hover pills, play glyph, small state chips — all monochrome and translucent
imagery.image_shape: large rounded rectangles (subtle radius) in a 2-column grid; the media fills the tile

interaction_feel.feedback_style: quiet and instantaneous — hover reveals affordances, selection is a subtle fill
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: media tile reveals a top-right action pill (favorite/reuse/more), a bottom-left play+prompt title, and a bottom-right extend/animate star
interaction_feel.transition_personality: smooth glide — continuity over spectacle; the composer morphs, the editor cross-fades
interaction_feel.loading_style: in-place progress; generated media streams into its tile

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: subtle — a small send arrow, not a shouted button; the panel states cost plainly ('Generisanje će koristiti 48 kredita')

overview.primary_technology: CSS + JS transitions; media playback is the spectacle

background_effects.description: no animated background; the media grid is the visual field

scroll_morphing.description: the composer stays fixed and translucent while the media grid scrolls beneath it — a persistent floating layer over a moving canvas

text_effects.description: the prompt-as-title simply fades in with the card chrome on hover

image_effects.description: on hover the media dims very slightly and floating monochrome controls fade in over it

params.reveal_animation: media streams in as it generates

params.blur_radius: the floating composer is subtly translucent/blurred over the grid

visual_effects.composite_notes: Flow's readability engine is exactly one thing: the dark room. Chrome is achromatic and near-invisible so media is the sole source of color and light; a subtly frosted floating composer keeps controls present without stealing the field. THIS IS THE ONE THING WE CANNOT COPY — the platform is cream with hard ink borders and a yellow accent, the opposite of a dark room. So the fusion keeps Flow's SKELETON (grid-as-canvas, persistent contextual composer, drop-up model-driven panel, media-as-editor route, prompt-as-identity, hover-reveal chrome, reuse-as-input) and must re-solve readability in the platform's SKIN without a dark ground — the central design problem of Phase 1 (see the three 'media on cream' directions in the report).
